ability.kogasa_addiction.aya.desc: Recording new mob, block, and damage types earns news value (mining and damage taken count in full, mob kills count only 1/10); higher news value means a higher equipment multiplier.
ability.kogasa_addiction.cirno.desc: Attacks very often apply Slowness to the target, with a small chance to slow yourself; when durability runs out, a large amount of growth is consumed to keep the item from breaking (on by default).
ability.kogasa_addiction.kogasa.desc: Each reinforcement level slightly increases the equipment overall multiplier (+10% by default).
ability.kogasa_addiction.koishi.desc: Melee attacks have a high chance to critically hit. Ranged attacks can also armor-piercingly crit and deal greatly increased damage to Endermen, Withers, and the Ender Dragon.
ability.kogasa_addiction.sakuya.desc: Attacks apply Instant Health to undead (damaging them) and Instant Damage to others; the higher the target max health, the stronger the effect.
ability.kogasa_addiction.tenshi.desc: Records damage taken and grants Resistance as the charge builds. When full, the next hit deals 10% of the target max health as bonus damage and resets. Hits apply high-level Slowness and Mining Fatigue, deal more damage to flying mobs, and randomly grant a stackable buff.

book.kogasa_addiction.entry.numbers.name: Numbers and Formulas
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.numbers.page: The heart of every panel is the total multiplier:$(br)$(li)$(l)Total$(0) = Reinforcement × Growth × Aya News$(br2)$(li)Reinforcement = 1 + reinforcement count × $(kogasa_cfg:kogasaReinforcementPerLevel) (Kogasa ability only)$(li)Growth = 1 + growth value (cap $(kogasa_cfg:maxGrowth), i.e. ×$(kogasa_cfg:maxGrowthPlusOne))$(li)News = 1 + news value (Aya only, cap $(kogasa_cfg:maxNewsValue), i.e. ×$(kogasa_cfg:maxNewsValuePlusOne))$(br2)Sealed equipment applies an extra ×0.5 while sealed.

Attack damage = (base damage + absorbed value) × total multiplier (whether absorbed value is inside the multiplier is controlled by absorbedValueIncludedInMultiplier).$(br2)Base damage = 1 + item attack: Kogasa Sword 1+3=4, the knife uses the trident base of 1+8=9, tools use their own attack values.$(br2)Actual damage dealt = displayed attack damage + 1 (bare-hand base damage, already included in the tooltip).

Attack speed = $(kogasa_cfg:attackSpeedCap) (cap) + speed modifier.$(br)Modifier = base item speed × (1 − progress); progress = min((growth + news) × $(kogasa_cfg:attackSpeedGrowthRatio), 1.0).$(br2)When (growth + news) × $(kogasa_cfg:attackSpeedGrowthRatio) ≥ 1.0 the speed is capped and shown in gold; slower base speeds gain the most from growth.

Mining speed = tier speed × (1 + reinforcements × $(kogasa_cfg:miningSpeedRatioPerReinforcement)) × (1 + growth) × news multiplier.$(br2)Knockback resistance: base $(kogasa_cfg:knockbackBase), asymptotic cap $(kogasa_cfg:knockbackMaxPerPiece) per piece; each reinforcement raises the cap by 50% (hard cap 1.0); growth and news value approach the cap.

Anvil reinforcement: $(kogasa_cfg:reinforcementCost) level(s) each, base cap $(kogasa_cfg:maxReinforcements); every +$(kogasa_cfg:growthPerExtraSlot) growth unlocks one extra slot (max +$(kogasa_cfg:maxExtraSlots), i.e. $(kogasa_cfg:maxReinforcementsTotal) total). Each reinforcement adds +$(kogasa_cfg:durabilityFixed) durability plus $(kogasa_cfg:durabilityRatio) scaling.$(br2)Absorption: weapons/tools absorb $(kogasa_cfg:weaponAbsorbedRatio) of the material attack damage, armor $(kogasa_cfg:armorAbsorbedRatio) of armor value; absorbed value enters the total multiplier by default.

Growth unlocks at $(kogasa_cfg:growthUnlockReinforcements) reinforcements. Each correct use adds +$(kogasa_cfg:growthPerUse), cap $(kogasa_cfg:maxGrowth).$(br2)Growth enchantments: one random enchantment per $(kogasa_cfg:growthPerEnchant) growth, level random 1 to max, default blacklist excludes Riptide/Silk Touch/Frost Walker/curses, capped at $(kogasa_cfg:maxGrowthEnchants).

Ability slots unlock in an arithmetic progression: $(kogasa_cfg:abilitySlotInitial) / $(kogasa_cfg:slot1) / $(kogasa_cfg:slot2) / $(kogasa_cfg:slot3) for slots 1-4 (the first is always available, cap $(kogasa_cfg:abilitySlotMax) slots); infusion costs $(kogasa_cfg:abilityInfusionCost) levels.$(br2)Sealed equipment (loot): ×0.5 attributes and inactive abilities, auto-unlocks at $(kogasa_cfg:lockedUnlockGrowth) growth and settles all growth enchantments earned while sealed.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.ranged_numbe: Draw/velocity baselines: bow 20 ticks (1.0s), crossbow 25 ticks (1.25s), trident and knife 10 ticks (0.5s); base velocity bow 3.0, crossbow 3.15, knife 3.0 (fixed baselines).$(br2)Display formulas: draw time = base ÷ √total − absorbed draw speed; velocity = base × √total × launch power multiplier.

Draw-speed absorption: each bow/crossbow reinforcement absorbs $(kogasa_cfg:drawSpeedAbsorbRatio) of the vanilla full draw time (2 ticks bow, 2.5 ticks crossbow); displayed draw time shrinks with reinforcements, minimum 1 tick.

Ranged growth features: Pierce I at $(kogasa_cfg:bowPierceGrowth) growth; double shot at $(kogasa_cfg:multishot2Growth) (±$(kogasa_cfg:multishotSpreadHalf)°); triple at $(kogasa_cfg:multishot3Growth) (±$(kogasa_cfg:multishotSpread)°); crossbow auto-reload at $(kogasa_cfg:autoReloadGrowth).$(br2)No-consume arrow chance starts at $(kogasa_cfg:noConsumeStartGrowth) growth and reaches 100% at $(kogasa_cfg:noConsumeFullGrowth), linear in between.

Knife break chance: base $(kogasa_cfg:knifeBreakChance) on pickup, −$(kogasa_cfg:knifeBreakReduction) per reinforcement/growth point; broken knives are repaired in the anvil with a Sakuya ingot ($(kogasa_cfg:knifeRepairCost) levels, up to 3 per operation). Initial throw velocity $(kogasa_cfg:knifeThrowVelocity) (vanilla trident ≈ 2.5).
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.ability_numb: Kogasa: reinforcement multiplier +$(kogasa_cfg:kogasaReinforcementPerLevel) per level inside the total chain; ranged streak +$(kogasa_cfg:kogasaStreakBonus) per consecutive hit ($(kogasa_cfg:kogasaStreakWindow)s window, cap $(kogasa_cfg:kogasaStreakMax)).$(br2)Aya: +$(kogasa_cfg:newsValuePerRecord) news value per new record (cap $(kogasa_cfg:maxNewsValue); mob kills count only 1/10, i.e. +$(kogasa_cfg:newsValuePerRecordTenth)); ranged hits grant the shooter Speed I for $(kogasa_cfg:ayaSpeedDuration)s and Haste I for $(kogasa_cfg:ayaHasteDuration)s.

Cirno: melee $(kogasa_cfg:cirnoSlowChance) Slowness level $(kogasa_cfg:cirnoSlowLevel) for $(kogasa_cfg:cirnoSlowDuration)s on target, $(kogasa_cfg:cirnoSelfSlowChance) Slowness I for $(kogasa_cfg:cirnoSelfSlowDuration)s on self; ranged plain arrows apply Slowness level $(kogasa_cfg:cirnoSlownessLevel) for $(kogasa_cfg:cirnoSlownessDurationSeconds)s, potions get +$(kogasa_cfg:cirnoPotionLevelBonus) levels and ×$(kogasa_cfg:cirnoPotionDurationMultiplier) duration.$(br2)Consumes $(kogasa_cfg:cirnoReviveGrowthCost) growth to survive durability loss (configurable).

Koishi: melee $(kogasa_cfg:koishiCritChance) crit ×$(kogasa_cfg:koishiCritMultiplier); ranged $(kogasa_cfg:koishiRangedCritChance) armor-piercing crit ×$(kogasa_cfg:koishiRangedCritMultiplier), ×$(kogasa_cfg:koishiProjectileImmuneMultiplier) vs Endermen and Withers below half health, ×$(kogasa_cfg:koishiProjectileImmuneSquared) (applied twice) vs the Ender Dragon.$(br2)$(kogasa_cfg:koishiGhastKills) Ghasts killed by reflected fireballs → 1 Koishi ingot.

Tenshi: charging $(kogasa_cfg:tenshiDomainThreshold) damage triggers the realm, the next hit deals $(kogasa_cfg:tenshiBurstRatio) of the target max health as bonus damage; hits apply Slowness and Mining Fatigue for $(kogasa_cfg:tenshiDebuffDuration)s; ×$(kogasa_cfg:tenshiFlyingMultiplier) damage vs flying mobs.$(br2)Sakuya: $(kogasa_cfg:sakuyaTimestopSeconds)s timestop per equipment piece (radius $(kogasa_cfg:sakuyaTimestopRadius), cooldown $(kogasa_cfg:sakuyaTimestopCooldown)s); at each day start, $(kogasa_cfg:sakuyaIngotChance) chance for an ingot when the coordinate digit-sum condition holds.

book.kogasa_addiction.category.growth.de: Information on growth value, anvil reinforcement, absorption, and ability slots.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.ability_ingo: Aya, Cirno, Koishi, Kogasa, Sakuya, and Tenshi Ingots correspond to the exclusive abilities of these six characters. Ability ingots are primarily used to infuse equipment at an anvil.

Their acquisition methods vary: Kogasa Ingots from blast furnaces; Aya Ingots from photography and shooting; Cirno Ingots from ice and snow; Koishi Ingots from reflecting fireballs at Ghasts; Tenshi Ingots from beacon bases at extreme heights; and Sakuya Ingots, hidden where the digit sum of the absolute coordinate total is divisible by 3 (see the respective ability chapters for details).
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.ability_slot: Equipment has one ability slot by default. When growth reaches a certain threshold, a second ability slot is unlocked; the default threshold is 50%.

Ability ingots can only be infused when the equipment does not already have that ability and has a free ability slot. The default infusion cost is 3 experience levels. Special ammo (potions/fireworks) does not occupy an ability slot.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.admin_comman: The following commands require permission level 2 (typically administrator/OP). They are suitable for testing and troubleshooting and are not recommended for casual survival gameplay. The one exception is $(6)/kogasa info$(0): it only reads equipment data and changes nothing, so any player may use it.
If you need to query equipment details, you can also use $(6)/kogasa info$(0).

Below are detailed descriptions of all available commands.$(br2)$(li)$(l)/kogasa info$(0): View detailed data of the main-hand equipment (reinforcement, growth, abilities, ammo, etc.).$(li)$(l)/kogasa grow <amount>$(0): Increase the equipment's growth value.$(li)$(l)/kogasa reinforce <item>$(0): Simulate a reinforcement using the specified item.

$(li)$(l)/kogasa reset$(0): Clear all reinforcement and growth data.$(li)$(l)/kogasa enchant <enchantment> <level>$(0): Directly add or overwrite an enchantment.$(li)$(l)/kogasa growenchant <count>$(0): Force trigger growth enchantment rolls.$(li)$(l)/kogasa removeenchant <enchantment>$(0): Remove the specified enchantment.$(li)$(l)/kogasa clearenchants$(0): Clear all enchantments.$(li)$(l)/kogasa setenchantlevel <enchantment> <level>$(0): Change the level of an existing enchantment.$(li)$(l)/kogasa resetgrowthenchant$(0): Reset the growth-enchant count and failure flag.

$(li)$(l)/kogasa triggerenchant$(0): Grant growth enchantments based on current growth value.$(br2)[Ability Control]$(br)$(li)$(l)/kogasa addability <abilityID>$(0): Infuse an ability into the equipment.$(li)$(l)/kogasa removeability <abilityID>$(0): Remove an ability.$(li)$(l)/kogasa clearabilities$(0): Clear all abilities.$(li)$(l)/kogasa seal [abilityID]$(0): Seal the held equipment (random ability if omitted); while sealed, attributes are -50% and abilities are inactive.$(li)$(l)/kogasa unseal$(0): Lift the seal.

[Aya News Value]$(br)$(li)$(l)/kogasa newsvalue <amount>$(0): Add news value to Aya equipment.$(li)$(l)/kogasa setnewsvalue <value>$(0): Set the news value directly.$(br2)[Bow/Crossbow Potion Ammo]$(br)$(li)$(l)/kogasa setammo potion <potion>$(0): Load regular potion.$(li)$(l)/kogasa setammo splash <potion>$(0): Load splash potion.$(li)$(l)/kogasa setammo lingering <potion>$(0): Load lingering potion.$(br2)Loading ammo does not occupy an ability slot.

[Bow/Crossbow Special Ammo]$(br)$(li)$(l)/kogasa setammo firework$(0): Load firework ammo (requires holding a firework in the offhand).$(li)$(l)/kogasa clearammo$(0): Clear the loaded ammo.$(br2)[Misc]$(br)$(li)$(l)/kogasa resetfirstjoin$(0): Reset your own 'first join reward' status.
Combine an Aya Ingot with equipment in an anvil to infuse Aya's ability. Equipment with this ability records the types of mobs first defeated, block types first mined, and damage types first taken by the player, and gains News Value. Mining and damage records count in full, mob kills count only 1/10.
News Value contributes to the equipment's overall stat multiplier. Ranged hits can also trigger Speed and Haste effects; specific durations and levels are determined by config.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.aya_arrow.pa: The Aya Arrow is an exclusive arrow item usable by the Aya Bow or Aya Crossbow. The exclusive arrow entity returns the corresponding Aya Arrow item when it can be picked up; tipped Aya Arrows keep their potion effects.
Aya Arrows also work with tipped-arrow mechanics: 8 Aya Arrows around 1 Lingering Potion craft 8 Aya Arrows carrying that potion's effects.
The Aya Arrow crafting recipe is shown here. Aya Arrows can also be combined with a Lingering Potion to craft potion-tipped Aya Arrows.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.cirno_abilit: Cirno's melee ability attempts to apply Slowness to the target and has a small chance to apply Slowness to the user as well. Specific chances, durations, and levels are determined by config. Ranged attacks do not apply Slowness to the user, and provide significant bonuses to tipped arrows.

When equipment with Cirno's ability is about to break from durability loss, the system consumes the specified growth value to prevent it from breaking during that instance. If there is insufficient growth value, the equipment breaks normally. The revival feature can be disabled in config.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.equipment_in: Current equipment includes the Kogasa sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, and hoe; the Tenshi helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots; and the Aya bow, crossbow, and arrow. They share a unified growth-equipment data structure.

The specific effects of reinforcement and growth on stats depend on the equipment type and configs. View the item tooltip to learn about the current equipment's actual multiplier, reinforcement, growth, and ability information.
The Kogasa Sword crafting recipe is shown here. Other equipment recipes are similar; please query the recipe book and JEI for specifics.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.growth.name: Growth System
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.growth.page1: Growth value is stored within the data of individual equipment pieces, not as a global player level. Whether growth is unlocked depends on the equipment's reinforcement count and config settings.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.growth.page2: Currently supported growth sources include: attacking entities, breaking blocks, tool actions (axe stripping, shovel flattening, hoe tilling), and taking damage; these actions add growth to every equipped Kogasa piece (main hand, off hand, and four armor slots). Firing a bow or crossbow only adds growth to that weapon.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.growth.page3: Accumulating growth value grants a series of rewards. These include: stat increases for the equipment, growth enchantments, and unlocking ability slots and reinforcement slots.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.growth_encha: Growth enchantments are a new enchantment acquisition mechanic introduced by this mod. Their max level is the vanilla max level + 1, and they ignore vanilla enchantment conflict rules.

Growth enchantments trigger when the equipment's growth value reaches a config-defined threshold. Upon triggering, it randomly selects an existing enchantment that has not reached (vanilla max level + 1) and increases its level. If all enchantments have reached their limits, it attempts to grant a new enchantment; otherwise, a message pops up indicating that growth enchantments have reached their limit.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.introduction: Welcome to Kogasa's Growth Equipment Manual
This mod introduces growth, reinforcement, absorption, and character ability systems to certain weapons, tools, armor, and ranged equipment. This manual explains how these mechanics work together.
Specific equipment values are affected by config files. If a server administrator has adjusted the configs, please refer to the actual in-game display and server rules.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.kogasa_abili: Kogasa's ability grants an additional overall multiplier based on the reinforcement level.
The ranged hit streak effect is also controlled by independent configs. Please refer to your current config for specific bonuses, streak reset time, and max streak count.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.koishi_abili: Koishi's ability has a high chance to trigger critical hits. Ranged attacks use armor-piercing crits and deal extra damage to Endermen, Withers below 50% health, and Ender Dragons.

Obtaining Koishi Ingots is related to the number of Ghasts killed by reflecting fireballs while invisible. By default, killing 2 Ghasts grants 1 Koishi Ingot. By the way, the ghasts from Twilight Forest are also counted.
1. Craft or obtain a piece of equipment from this mod.$(br)(Under default configs, you will be given a piece of equipment with a random ability upon first joining the world)$(br)2. Reinforce the equipment in an anvil using materials of the same category.$(br)3. Once the config-defined reinforcement count is reached, the equipment can accumulate growth through eligible actions.

4. Place the equipment and an ability ingot into an anvil to infuse the corresponding character ability.$(br)5. Hold the modifier key on the item tooltip to view growth, reinforcement, and ability information.$(br)6. Use the mod's commands to view detailed equipment data, or for debugging and troubleshooting.$(br)7. Most features of this mod can be toggled or adjusted in the config file.$(br)Wishing you a pleasant forging journey in Gensokyo!
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.ranged_basic: The Aya Bow and Aya Crossbow keep the main controls of vanilla bows and crossbows and are integrated into the unified data system as growable equipment. Draw/charge time, piercing, multishot, ammo, and some enchantment effects are handled by this mod's logic.

Ranged abilities include Aya's Speed/Haste on hit, Cirno's Slowness and potion bonuses, Koishi's ranged crits, Kogasa's hit streak bonus, and Tenshi's on-hit debuffs and bonus damage against flying mobs. Specific behaviors depend on the abilities infused into the equipment and configs.

The Aya Crossbow crafting recipe is shown here. The Aya Bow replaces the sticks in the vanilla bow recipe with Aya Ingots; the Aya Crossbow uses Aya Ingots, iron ingots, string, and a tripwire hook. Please query the recipe book and JEI for specifics.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.reinforcemen: Place the equipment on the left side of the anvil, and a valid material of the same category on the right side (bows and crossbows can be reinforced with 16 arrows, and arrows do not count towards the material duplication limit). Upon success, the equipment's reinforcement level increases and it absorbs a portion of the material's base value into its own stats.

The registry ID of reinforcement materials is recorded. The same equipment cannot use the same registered item as an absorption material twice, nor can it absorb itself. Reinforcement limits, experience costs, and absorption ratios can be adjusted via config.
When reinforcing equipment at an anvil, place the equipment on the left side and a valid reinforcement material on the right side. For specific information, please query JEI.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.sakuya_abili: Obtaining a Sakuya Ingot is tied to coordinates. At the start of each in-game day, the system takes the absolute values of the player's floored X, Z, and Y coordinates, adds them together, then sums the digits of that total. If the digit sum is divisible by 3, there is a high chance to receive a Sakuya Ingot.

When infused into equipment via an anvil, attacks will apply Instant Health or Instant Damage depending on whether the target is undead. You can also activate a time stop ability by pressing X (or any other key you've set); the time stop radius and duration can be adjusted in config.

Applying Instant Health to undead mobs (like Zombies and Skeletons) causes severe damage; applying Instant Damage to non-undead mobs (like Spiders and Creepers) delivers a burst strike. This is an extremely effective tactic against high-health targets.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.sakuya_knife: Sakuya Knife is a trident-like weapon that excels at both ranged and melee combat. It can absorb tridents, swords, or knives as reinforcement materials.

Sakuya Knife has no durability limit and a maximum stack size of 3, but each throw has a chance to break it. A broken knife can be repaired in an anvil by combining it with a Sakuya Ingot, up to 3 knives at a time; any excess stays in the input slot, and all data is retained. Higher reinforcement counts and growth both reduce this chance, but even at maximum reinforcement and growth there is still a chance to break.
This is the crafting recipe for Sakuya's Knife.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.tenshi_abili: Tenshi: Girl of the Non-Thinker, Non-Non-Thinker

Wearing armor with Tenshi's ability accumulates damage taken into a 'State of No-Thought, No-Mind'. For every quarter of the threshold reached, gain one level of Resistance (rounded down, max 4 levels); single-hit overflow beyond the threshold is not recorded.

Once the threshold is reached, the next hit deals extra damage based on the configured percentage (default 10%) of the target's max health, then clears the record. The record resets to zero upon death or when Cirno's equipment revival ability triggers.

Melee or ranged hits apply Slowness VII and Mining Fatigue VII; non-boss flying mobs take increased damage based on a configured multiplier (default 2x). Every hit also randomly grants a vanilla buff: each time adding 10 seconds and increasing the level by 1, up to a max duration of 60 seconds and a max level of IV. Tenshi arrows deal magic damage and are not nullified by arrow immunity.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.troubleshoot: Anvil reinforcement related: Confirm the left side is a mod equipment piece, the right side material belongs to the correct tag category, and that this item type hasn't been absorbed by this equipment before. If issues persist, query JEI for reinforcement recipes.
Growth related: Confirm the growth value is sufficient to trigger growth enchantments or unlock ability slots. If it doesn't trigger when it should, try using commands like /kogasa triggerenchant.
If you encounter other issues, please consult this book and the config file first. If the problem persists, contact the mod author or seek help in the mod community.
book.kogasa_addiction.kogasa_manual.land: Welcome to Kogasa's Growth Equipment Manual! $(br2)This manual covers equipment growth, anvil reinforcement, material absorption, character abilities, ranged weapons, and administrator debugging tools. Most values can be modified via config files; please refer to in-game behavior as the final standard.
